polynomial is the product of the roots of all 2025 quadratic factors. Since each quadratic factor has roots \(x_1\) and \(x_2\), the product of the roots of the polynomial is:
   \[
   \prod_{k=1}^{2025} \left( \frac{2 + \sqrt{4 + 3k}}{k} \cdot \frac{2 - \sqrt{4 + 3k}}{k} \right) = \prod_{k=1}^{2025} \frac{4 - (4 + 3k)}{k^2} = \prod_{k=1}^{2025} \frac{-3k}{k^2} = \prod_{k=1}^{2025} \frac{-3}{k} = (-3)^{2025} \prod_{k=1}^{2025} \frac{1}{k} = (-3)^{2025} \cdot \frac{1}{2025!}
   \]
